title: Google News Scraper
description: Read Google News RSS metadata by keyword, topic, or top headlines. This is not an official Google API; verify the current feed terms for your use.

queries.title: Search Keywords
queries.description: Keywords or phrases to search in Google News, e.g. "artificial intelligence", "Tesla earnings", or "public procurement". Agents should use focused phrases for cleaner briefs.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Google News topic sections for broad monitoring: WORLD, NATION, BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, ENTERTAINMENT, SPORTS, SCIENCE, HEALTH.

topHeadlines.title: Top Headlines
topHeadlines.description: If enabled, also fetch the main top-headlines feed for the selected country/language.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code for the news edition (e.g. "US", "GB", "IN").

maxArticlesPerFeed.title: Max Articles Per Feed
maxArticlesPerFeed.description: Maximum articles to extract per query/topic/feed. Use 5-10 for agent summaries and small briefs; Google News RSS commonly returns up to about 100 items per feed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually keep disabled for small RSS requests. Direct and custom proxy URL modes are supported when explicitly configured.
